title: Local explorer annotation request
description: POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/annotations; application/json and X-Nexo-Editor: 1 required. Only the localhost:8080 and 127.0.0.1:8080 origins are accepted. Body limit: 32768 bytes. Mapping IDs must exist in explorer/mapping.json. No client-selected file paths.

request_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUID. Reuse for unchanged retries; changed content with the same ID returns 409.

flow_id.description: A flow ID from the mapping.

selected_text.description: Selected page text. Text or at least one target is required. CRLF is normalized to LF.

note.description: User's words; CRLF is normalized to LF. Control characters other than tab/newline are rejected.

id.description: Known mapping ID; kind/ID pairs must be distinct.

label.description: Optional client hint, ignored when saving; labels come from the mapping.

result.description: 201 after a durable new write; 200 after durable confirmation of an identical retry. Errors: 400 invalid request, 403 untrusted origin/host, 409 ID/content conflict, 503 persistence unavailable.
